notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Sprint now will consume energy only when enemies are nearby
 Added PSO Precaching to reduce stuttering when playing for the first time
 Fixed bow aim not working if pressed while launch arrow animation is running
 Fixed bookshelf not having collisions on chapter 7
 Some changes in player HUD
 Small adjustments in Zeira unarmed run animation
 Small adjustments in Kholdir Two-handed Sword movement animations
 Other small fixes and adjustments

notes.title: 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where input could get lost when starting a new game

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Increased by 0.5x damage multipliers of first four common special attacks (combos) on all three characters
 Increased a bit energy (stamina) restoration speed
 Changes in light stun (stagger) calculation to maintain same enemy behavior on harder difficulty levels
 Added more potions at some points on chapters 5, 6 and 9
 Fixes in AI behaviors of Spiders, Mummies and Snow creatures
 Lowered a bit default music volume
 Avoid closing pop-up messages when moving gamepad sticks
 Other small fixes and corrections
